questions.prompt: What does an on-delay timer do when its coil is first energized?
questions.answer: Starts timing while contacts stay normal
options: Starts timing while contacts stay normal
Immediately returns all contacts to normal after timing
Starts only after coil power is removed
questions.explanation: The on-delay contacts change after the preset interval with the coil energized.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.
reviewCue.excerpt: ► When coil is energized, relay’s timing mechanism begins to run, but contacts remain in the normal state ► Once preset time delay is reached, contacts move to their energized states ► Contacts remain in energized states until coil is de-energized 122

questions.prompt: When does an off-delay timer begin its timing interval?
options: Only when its coil is first energized
questions.explanation: Its contacts actuate immediately when energized and remain held for the delay after de-energizing.
